s: A company is developing a new on-demand video application that is based on microservices. The application will have 5 million users at launch and will have 30 million users after 6 months. The company has deployed the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate. The company developed the application by using ECS services that use the HTTPS protocol. A solutions architect needs to implement updates to the application by using blue/green deployments. The solution must distribute traffic to each ECS service through a load balancer. The application must automatically adjust the number of tasks in response to an Amazon CloudWatch alarm. Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure the ECS services to use the blue/green deployment type and a Network Load Balancer. Request increases to the service quota for tasks per service to meet the demand.
Configure the ECS services to use the blue/green deployment type and a Network Load Balancer. Implement an Auto Scaling group for each ECS service by using the Cluster Autoscaler.
Configure the ECS services to use the blue/green deployment type and an Application Load Balancer. Implement an Auto Seating group for each ECS service by using the Cluster Autoscaler.
Configure the ECS services to use the blue/green deployment type and an Application Load Balancer. Implement Service Auto Scaling for each ECS service.
x: ECS tasks on Fargate scale with ECS Service Auto Scaling, driven by CloudWatch alarms. Cluster Autoscaler is a Kubernetes tool, and Fargate has no Auto Scaling group to attach it to. ALB is right for HTTPS services with blue/green deployments.

w.y: The services use HTTPS and need blue/green deployments, so an Application Load Balancer with CodeDeploy blue/green deployment for ECS fits. On Fargate there are no instances to scale. Task count is changed by ECS Service Auto Scaling (Application Auto Scaling), which acts on CloudWatch alarms through step or target tracking policies.

o.A: Raising the tasks-per-service quota doesn't add or remove tasks automatically in response to an alarm.
o.B: Cluster Autoscaler is a Kubernetes tool, and Fargate has no Auto Scaling group of instances to scale.
o.C: The ALB is right, but Cluster Autoscaler and Auto Scaling groups don't apply to ECS tasks on Fargate.
o.D: Correct: an ALB with blue/green deployment plus ECS Service Auto Scaling driven by CloudWatch alarms.

s: CodeDeploy blue/green deployments for Amazon ECS
Automatically scale your Amazon ECS service
Use predefined increments based on CloudWatch alarms to scale Amazon ECS services
